mechanism_narrative: A lower current federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 4.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.3 percentage points over three months signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE rises by more than 0.3 percentage points over a 3-month period, 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor market growth (PAYEMS) combined with high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an overheating economy and impending monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In instances where PAYEMS growth is above 0.5% and FEDFUNDS is above 5.0%, 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a monthly decline in housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 0.5% signals an impending economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the late-cycle expansion regime, when HOUST declines > 0.5% in 1 month, 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (index base 2017=100) signals a manufacturing slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO falls below 100 in a month, 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher current level of retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, supporting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When RSAFS is above the 75th percentile, 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly rise in the CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals accelerating inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL rises > 0.2pp in 1 month, 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market (UNRATE below 4.5%), a strong monthly increase in employment (PAYEMS) signals robust economic growth without immediate inflation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 4.5% and PAYEMS rises > 0.3% in 1 month
failure_condition: In instances where UNRATE < 4.5% and PAYEMS rises > 0.3% in 1 month, 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
